title: Interstellar
description: A team leaves Earth to search for a future for humanity, blending family bonds, time, gravity, and the scale of space.

title: Back to the Future
description: A teenager is sent into the past and must repair a chain of events while finding his way home.

title: The Martian
description: An isolated astronaut turns scientific problem solving into a route home while people on Earth coordinate a rescue.

title: Paddington 2
description: A kind bear and his friends navigate a mistaken accusation with warmth, wit, and generous community spirit.

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
description: A precise concierge and his young protégé become entangled in a fast-moving caper shaped by loyalty and memory.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
description: A hobbit named Frodo carries a dangerous burden across a vast landscape with a small fellowship, where friendship is tested by fear and power.

title: Arrival
description: A linguist works to communicate with visitors from beyond Earth as language, memory, and time reshape her choices.

title: Knives Out
description: A detective interviews a wealthy family after a novelist dies, turning inheritance, secrets, and assumptions into a playful puzzle.

title: Spirited Away
description: A child in a strange spirit world learns courage and compassion while trying to rescue her transformed parents.

title: The Princess Bride
description: A story of true love, wit, swordplay, and friendship moves between a storyteller and an exuberant adventure.

title: Hidden Figures
description: Three mathematicians at NASA use expertise and persistence to challenge barriers and help a space mission succeed.

title: The Iron Giant
description: A boy befriends a mysterious robot and must protect him while discovering what it means to choose one’s own purpose.

title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
description: Four children travel through a wardrobe into Narnia, where they discover a conflict that will decide the fate of the enchanted land.
